description: What changed in the collection, newest first: one line per change (an import, Sleeve deck or a deleted deck is ONE line), each with who made it (`by`) and whether it was undone. Filters: deck (id or name) or place (id or name) a change touched, source (web, assistant, api_key, partner, import, swap), kind, days (default all the plan shows). Page with `before` = `next_before`. Pass op_id (a line's) to open that change: `opened` lists every card it touched. Free reads the last 90 days: relay `plan_limit` when present. Changes nothing.

deck.description: Only changes that touched this deck (id or name)

op_id.description: Open one change: its line and every card it touched

place.description: Only changes that moved cards into or out of this place (location id or name)

name: recent_activity

lines.description: Newest first; empty when op_id opens a change

by.description: Who made the change: say so when it was not you

kind.description: web: the player in the web app; assistant, api_key, partner: by `name`; import; swap

name.description: The assistant's, key's or partner's name as it was then

card.description: The card, when the change touched one; null for several (open it with op_id)

anyOf.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

text.description: The line in words, starting with who made it

undo_of.description: This line is an undo: the change it put back

undone.description: An undo put this change back

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last

older_hidden.description: Entries older than the plan shows, kept and shown on Plus

opened.description: The change op_id named, with every card it touched, oldest first
